items.title: Bob Wilber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: Pug and I went to Rome... recording the soundtrack... Pug and I are doing a Benny Goodman tribute... Pug and I, in Toulouse, working on these things.

ctx.x: That must have been interesting to hear them after all that time.

And the band was made up of a lot of great players, but we had a three hour rehearsal on a Saturday morning, and a two hour concert that afternoon. And the playing was so good that we could issue the CD with the numbers played on the CD exactly as we did at the concert. And of course Pug sang some marvelous songs on it. I had some of my Ellington transcriptions and Goodman transcriptions. Yeah, I felt good about doing that.
You finally got to play with Benny Goodman in the ‘50s? © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
